title: BiggerPockets or Rich Dad vs Our Wealth Plan
h1: BiggerPockets or Rich Dad vs a written wealth plan
keyLine: A forum and a book are starting tools. Our plan is a 12-month order for your file.
description: BiggerPockets and Rich Dad compared with Legacy Wealth Blueprint: jobs, public competitor prices, and Preston Seo's wealth plan. We do not print our tuition.
answer: BiggerPockets is a real estate community with free podcasts and a paid Pro plan for tools. Rich Dad is a brand around Robert Kiyosaki's book. Both can start you. Neither writes a 12-month plan from your tax return. Legacy Wealth Blueprint is the plan Preston Seo teaches: tax, debt, income, investing, and protection in one order, plus a coach and a CPA brief. He built that after a corporate job, a house-hacked duplex, and a $15M+ portfolio with his wife. Use the book or the forum first. Use us when you want one written order, not another story.
criteriaIntro: The comparison pole is our wealth plan, not a trophy between two other brands. Competitor prices come from pages we opened. Our tuition is not on this page.

blocks.heading: Where this comparison sits
paragraphs: [Preston Seo](/about/preston-seo) did not build Legacy Investing Show as a BiggerPockets clone or a Rich Dad sequel. The [about page](/about) says he left a corporate job, studied taxes and cash flow, and with his wife built a $15M+ real estate portfolio. The system underneath that is what Blueprint sells: a written Wealth Strategy Snapshot, a dedicated guide, weekly coaching, and a brief you hand to your own CPA.
BiggerPockets helps you study deals. The Rich Dad book jogs how you see a paycheck. Those are useful. They are not the same job as a 12-month wealth plan.

blocks.heading: How to pick this month
paragraphs: If you still believe your salary is the only asset you will ever have, read Rich Dad Poor Dad once. Then stop. Do not buy a stack of sequels until you can explain one local rental in numbers.

If you can already explain cap rate in a sentence (yearly net rent divided by price), use free BiggerPockets content or our [rental cash flow tool](/tools/rental-property-cash-flow). Pay for Pro only when a calculator or form is in your way every week. See [what to know before Pro](/compare/biggerpockets-what-to-know).
If the leak is a W-2 tax bill, debt, and investing at once, that is our lane. Read [what's in Blueprint](/compare/legacy-wealth-blueprint-what-to-know).

faqs.q: Should I pick BiggerPockets or Rich Dad?
faqs.a: Use the book once if you need a mindset jolt. Use BiggerPockets for models and math. That choice is not the same as choosing a wealth plan.
Only if your next job is tax, debt, and investing in one order. It will not replace forums for underwriting listings.

faqs.q: Does any of this file my taxes?
faqs.a: No. See [tax course vs a CPA](/compare/tax-course-vs-cpa). Blueprint still sends you back to your CPA.
